summary: EMA Trend Gate cross-asset validation on BNB/USDT completed with 0.432 OOS Sharpe (837 trades, 57 windows). BNB underperforms all other tested assets: SOL (1.373), BTC (0.998), ETH (0.489). Strategy generalizes to exchange tokens but with marginal Sharpe barely above 0.4 threshold. Evidence score 55 below 60 threshold - strategy meets status gate but not evidence quality threshold.

key_lessons.lesson: BNB is the worst-performing asset in EMA Trend Gate series
key_lessons.specific_finding: BNB achieved 0.432 OOS Sharpe vs SOL 1.373 (+218%), BTC 0.998 (+131%), ETH 0.489 (+13%). Exchange token utility-driven demand creates distinct volatility regime that reduces strategy effectiveness.

key_lessons.lesson: Cross-asset generalization partially confirmed but asset-specific tuning required
key_lessons.specific_finding: Same parameters (EMA 50/20, RSI 14, 35/50 thresholds, 96 hold bars) produce widely varying results across assets. SOL and BTC thrive while BNB struggles, indicating exchange tokens need asset-specific parameter adjustment.

key_lessons.lesson: Marginal OOS Sharpe indicates strategy vulnerability for exchange tokens
key_lessons.specific_finding: 0.432 barely exceeds 0.4 threshold - strategy is borderline robust for BNB. The 4h EMA regime filter may not adequately capture exchange token-specific volatility patterns (utility demand cycles, burn events, staking rewards).

next_actions.action: Exclude BNB from core strategy deployment or create asset-specific variant
next_actions.rationale: BNB underperforms all other tested assets with marginal 0.432 Sharpe. Including BNB in deployment would reduce overall portfolio performance without additional diversification benefit.

next_actions.action: Test asset-specific parameter tuning for BNB (looser RSI thresholds, longer hold periods)
next_actions.rationale: Exchange tokens may require different RSI oversold/overbought levels (e.g., 30/70 instead of 35/50) and longer hold periods to capture utility-driven price cycles.

next_actions.action: Evaluate funding rate or staking yield as regime filter instead of 4h EMA
next_actions.rationale: Exchange token volatility may be more driven by utility events (token burns, staking rewards) than pure trend following. Alternative regime filters may improve BNB performance.
